scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Peter--Weyl central idempotent formula, Weyl character and integration formulas, and an exact signed trigonometric integral.
scientific_integrity.unproved_limits: No assertion of bibliographic uniqueness beyond the documented searches; no independent validation is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved only for a single complete irreducible block on SU(2).
No intermediate Lp operator norms or higher-rank compact-group analogues are claimed.
An older equivalent evaluation of the SU(2) character L1 norm may exist under different terminology.
title: Exact endpoint norms of single Peter--Weyl blocks on \(SU(2)\)
